title: Sample-Smooth Spaces: A Convenient Category for Differentiable Probabilistic Programming
summary: We introduce the category $\mathbf{SSS}$ of sample-smooth spaces over a mixed site. The test objects are the products $Ω_n := \mathbb{R}^n \times Ω$ of a Cartesian space with the universal Hilbert cube $Ω$ carrying all universally measurable sets, and a space is a set with a family of admissible plots $Ω_n \to \mathcal{X}$ closed under precomposition. Smoothness and measurability are then not two structures glued along an axiom, but one structure over one site.
